title: BetterRTX Remastered
description: BetterRTX Remastered offers Ray-Tracing textures that replicate the Minecraft Bedrock RTX look.
body:
## 📷 Get that Bedrock RTX look on Java with BetterRTX!
![BetterRTX ON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8caeaa3cb0d020b3f5be85474c69b813182f705.jpeg)
![BetterRTX OFF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b2e042a2033ac5c92a351bcb41c0149e23a7e84.jpeg)
## ✅ Updated to the latest version every month.
This resource pack includes features such as:
- High Resolution (x128) Normal Maps for all blocks and items.
- Specular Maps for all blocks and items.
- Compatibility with most shaders.
- Can be used without path-tracing shaders (though it won't have the full RTX features)
## Get this and a LOT more 🎁
You can join my Patreon for _only $1_ a month, and get access to BetterRTX and ALL my other resource packs at the same time!
> The demo version is also available on this page but it only includes 50% of the block and item textures, good for seeing if your PC can handle it.

Download the **full version** here: https://www.patreon.com/parsafarvadian
